name: A Gentleman's Compendium of Amiable Beasts

source.note: Fennimore's copy of his rival's monster guide (easter-egg plan R2); ours.

summary: A best-selling guide to monsters by an author with one glass eye, annotated throughout in a furious pencil.
text: The owlbear page calls the creature affectionate if scratched behind the beak. In the margin, in pencil: "Affectionate?! It tore the boots off a mule in three seconds. Zero stars. A.F." Further on, beside the swamp hags: "Pure hearsay, no field measurements, prose like warm suet. How is this in a fourth printing? A.F."
